info.description: Prose fields written by the model or the operator, such as message and answer text and the `text` and `thinking` run stream events, are raw markdown: render CommonMark with tables, strikethrough and autolinks, and escape raw HTML. Within v1, responses change only additively: clients ignore unknown error codes, run stream event names and response fields.
